pages.text: $(bold)Glacio: The Final Frontier$()$(br)Mobs: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:glacio difficulty}}$() the vanilla strength, like every Tier 4 world$(br)Death penalty: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:glacio death}}$()$(br2)A world in the Proxima Centauri system: alien biomes, extreme cold and the most dangerous creatures you will face. Glacio is harder than the End and harder than Oblivion's Rift. The pack ends here.

$(bold)Environmental Hazards$()$(br)• $(bold)Extreme cold$(): 2 HP of damage every 5 seconds$(br)• $(bold)Mining fatigue$() from the alien environment$(br)• Alien mobs that are fast, strong and resistant$(br2)$(bold)Champion Density$()$(br)Glacio has the pack's highest Champion spawn rate (25%), and a Champion here has a 60% chance to gain custom affixes. You will meet Commanding and Summoning champions often.

$(bold)Why Come Here?$()$(br)Glacio has materials found nowhere else that the $(bold)MekaSuit Mk2$() needs. Together with Aethersteel and Primordial Essence from Oblivion's Rift, they complete the strongest armor set in the game.$(br2)$(bold)Alien Ruins$()$(br)Crashed ships and technology caches hold loot found nowhere else, and Glacio gear may carry affixes specific to this dimension.

$(bold)Planetary Rock Extraction$()$(br)Crush $(bold)Glacio Stone$() in Create Crushing Wheels or a Thermal Pulverizer to extract:$(br)• $(bold)Alien Isotope$() (20%): alien-tech integration$(br)• $(bold)Cryogenic Element$() (20%): cryo-fusion technology$(br)• Ice Shards (30%)

$(bold)Void Adaptation Enchantment$()$(br)Glacio mobs have a $(bold)12% chance$() to drop an enchanted book of $(bold)Void Adaptation$() (max level 2). On armor, it:$(br)• Negates mining fatigue from alien environments$(br)• Makes you immune to alien debuffs$(br)• Removes Glacio's mining fatigue even at level 1$(br2)With Thermal Regulation for cold immunity, the two make Glacio survivable.

$(bold)Preparation Checklist$()$(br)• MekaSuit (minimum)$(br)• Soulbound III on all gear$(br)• Thermal Regulation enchantment (level 3)$(br)• Void Adaptation enchantment$(br)• Full Vitality enchantment$(br)• Working RF infrastructure (Flux Networks recommended)$(br)• Emergency waystone or recall method$(br)• High-tier healing items$(br2)$(italic)Come here unprepared and Glacio will kill you.$()
